dispositions.decision: ACCEPTED_AND_FIXED. The cell scan and the roles scan are repeated on the commit that contains this text. The self-check table is unchanged.
ACCEPTED_AND_FIXED. The records supersede OCOR-DEV-REM-0037-requalified-rem0056-de79d986d7f3 and OCOR-DEV-REM-0056-de79d986d7f3. Both previous records hash the lane files.

qualifying_campaign.head: a68c47dad3610a1c284020e0ea28ef0c85c6be57
qualifying_campaign.residue: Four lane teardowns passed and the host residue check found no containers, networks, volumes or root image. The work directory is on the root filesystem, so the image cache was kept. Lane checkouts were removed.
qualifying_campaign.runs: Qualifying run of repair cycle 1 on a68c47dad3610a1c284020e0ea28ef0c85c6be57, after the tmp quota pre-check and signal cleanup. The run on 46835befb1a30e1bdf9ec0f9c87e2e6abac8c6e3 does not qualify this head. Collection and partition digests are unchanged. The shared image cache was mounted read-only in all four lanes. Fourteen locked host images, including the Fuseki base, were transferred and not pulled. The work directory is under the home filesystem, so the /tmp user-quota check was recorded and did not apply: usrquota was present, free quota was 26183036928 bytes and the four-lane budget was 12803400374 bytes. Duration 1779.773 s, 3620.227 s under the 5400 s cap and 1820.227 s under the 3600 s notification. Power was MAINS at both readings. Earlier executions on 6c0a233fe21c9cffd4ae914a5daf36e109502dab stay diagnostic. The commit that records this paragraph is not the executed head.

red_repair_cycle_2.note: No separate red commit. The four failing tests and the fix are together in b22debf2e08e805db56643030b17efafdd5e4da5. The historical red fingerprint f477a92adce5c4180f1648a7462e4fbae41a1e2e492b134a0de6f0800725c17b is not reused.

requalifications_remaining: None. The regression records are reports/evidence/G2/OCOR-DEV-REM-0037.requalified-rem0061.json (record_id OCOR-DEV-REM-0037-requalified-rem0061-b22debf2e08e) and reports/evidence/G2/OCOR-DEV-REM-0056.requalified-rem0061.json (record_id OCOR-DEV-REM-0056-requalified-rem0061-b22debf2e08e). Both cite commit b22debf2e08e805db56643030b17efafdd5e4da5, the commit on which the regression command ran, and replace the unsealed records on the same paths that cited 83d9b74648c14a2afb14904a2a83183274ece7c9. supersedes still names the sealed predecessors OCOR-DEV-REM-0037-requalified-rem0056-de79d986d7f3 and OCOR-DEV-REM-0056-de79d986d7f3; those files are unchanged. Both sealed records hash the lane files, the plan validator and the plan run state. completed_evidence_tasks does not list these two tasks, so the drift validator does not select them; that is not because the hashes are absent.
